parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, t.code, t.sport, t.name, t.status, t.area, t.scoring_pin, t.organizer_user_id, o.name AS creator_name, viewer.id AS viewer_id, viewer.name AS viewer_name, viewer.profile_complete AS viewer_ready, d.match_rules, d.squad_max, m.id AS match_id, m.match_no, m.division_id, m.status AS match_status, DATE_FORMAT(m.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduled_at, m.result_text, m.winner_entry_id, m.event_count, m.home_entry_id, m.away_entry_id, JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.summary') AS summary, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', e.id, 'team_id', tm.id, 'team_code', tm.code, 'name', tm.name, 'short', tm.short_name, 'captain_id', (SELECT x.user_id FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.role = 'CAPTAIN' AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1), 'players', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('user_id', ep.user_id, 'name', COALESCE(u.name, x.guest_name))) FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN team_members x ON x.id = ep.team_member_id LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.id = x.user_id WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id))) FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id) AS sides, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('user_id', p.user_id, 'name', pu.name)) FROM quick_match_people p JOIN app_users pu ON pu.id = p.user_id WHERE p.tournament_id = t.id) AS people, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('match_id', x.id, 'match_no', x.match_no, 'status', x.status, 'events', x.event_count, 'result_text', x.result_text, 'summary', JSON_EXTRACT(x.live, '$.summary'), 'scheduled_at', DATE_FORMAT(x.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'))) FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.tournament_id = t.id) AS matches, (SELECT CONCAT_WS('|', tu.id, REPLACE(tu.name, '|', ' '), tu.profile_complete, IFNULL(REPLACE(tu.jersey_name, '|', ' '), ''), IFNULL(tu.jersey_number, ''), IFNULL((SELECT s.role FROM app_user_sports s WHERE s.user_id = tu.id AND s.sport = t.sport), '')) FROM app_users tu WHERE tu.id = $3 AND tu.is_active = 1) AS target FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users o ON o.id = t.organizer_user_id JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 AND viewer.is_active = 1 JOIN tournament_matches m ON m.id = (SELECT MAX(z.id) FROM tournament_matches z WHERE z.tournament_id = t.id) JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = m.division_id WHERE t.code = $2 AND t.kind = 'QUICK'
